meta.rounding: all money is integer CAD cents converted with np.rint(dollars * 100); medians of an even count average the two middle cents half up, and means and runway tenths divide with ROUND_HALF_UP (ties away from zero), applied once at the metric boundary

definitions.income_cents: I: median of money_in across all monthly rows; an even row count averages the two middle cents half up
definitions.fixed_costs_cents: F: median across months of the per month row sum household_bills + insurance + loan_payments; part 1 only, never used in the runway
definitions.spending_cents: S: median of money_out across all monthly rows
definitions.buffer_cents: B: mean of avg_daily_balance over the last 6 rows sorted by month, rounded half up; thin history uses every available row
definitions.household_bills_cents: H: median of household_bills across all monthly rows
definitions.loan_payment_cents: P: monthly_payment from loans.csv when status is C or D (still running at the end of 2025), otherwise 0
definitions.gap_cents: gap: typical monthly spending S minus typical monthly income I
definitions.runway_deci_months: runway in tenths of a month: (buffer minus one off costs) divided by the monthly shortfall; 0 when the buffer is depleted, 1200 when there is no shortfall, otherwise rounded half up and capped at 1200

meta.checksum_recipe: row id = account_id:month sorted ascending; value = money_in_cents per row; SHA256 of LF joined id:value lines

provenance.agg: judge metrics over all monthly rows (I, F, S, H medians; B mean over the last 6 rows; pension sum); checksum value = money_in_cents
